work.name: University of Southern California, Viterbi School of Engineering
work.summary: Research intern at the ACME Lab at USC.
highlights: Contributed to the design of a **PLL based IC** for resonant-shift-based biosensing using magnetic nanoparticles.
Designed **PCB** for testing and characterization of neurostimulator IC.
Advisor: [Prof. Constantine Sideris](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=-7RMX3oAAAAJ&hl=en), Associate Professor, ACME Lab, USC Viterbi

projects.title: Design of Ultra-High Bandwidth Continuous Time Delta Sigma ADC
projects.organization: Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee (Undergraduate Thesis)
highlights: Proposed a **digital logic based ELD compensation scheme** for ELD>1 clock cycles for CT-DSM and verified logic through simulation both in MATLAB and ideal blocks in Cadence.
Targeting a **200MHz bandwidth** and **68dB SNDR** at a sampling rate of 9.6GHz.
Currently designing the modulator in **GF 22nm FDSOI** technology node.
Advisor: [Prof. Sarvana Kumar M.](https://ece.iitr.ac.in/saravana-kumar-m/), Assistant Professor, ECE Department, IIT Roorkee

projects.title: Designing CMOS Potentiostat for Electrochemical Biosensing
highlights: Implemented a **potentiostat** for glucose biosensing in **180nm CMOS technology node** in Cadence Virtuoso at schematic level.
Presented the research at the student research forum at **IEEE ISICAS 2024**.
Advisor: [Prof. Sarvana Kumar M.](https://ece.iitr.ac.in/saravana-kumar-m/), Assistant Professor, ECE Department, IIT Roorkee

projects.title: Design of OTA in 180nm node in Cadence Virtuoso
projects.organization: ECL-538 : Mixed Signal Circuit Design course
highlights: Designed a two-stage **Miller compensated OTA** in SCL 180nm pdk in Cadence Virtuoso using **gm/Id technique**.
Achieved a DC gain of **81dB**, UGB of **130 MHz**, and a phase margin of **47 degrees**.

projects.title: FRUC detection using periodic properties of edge intensity
highlights: Implemented algorithms for detection of video **Frame-Rate Up-Conversion (FRUC)** using periodic variation of frame edge intensity.
Edge intensity was measured using operators like **Kirsch**, **Prewitt**, and **Sobel** as well as **wavelet transform**, followed by **Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average** operation.
